context: Two managers prep a store-layout review
purpose: Teach: 通路/通話/品種/実体/原点/ネーム/努める/写し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店内の通路、品種ごとの動線、見直したい。
lines.en: I want to review the store layout—the traffic flow by product category.
lines.style: Direct and focused. Clips the opening. Businesslike but not cold. The tone of someone thinking out loud to a trusted colleague who can keep up.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、実体調査のデータ、原点となる現場で取りました。
lines.en: Right. The field study data came straight from the source location.
lines.style: Steady, confirmatory. Slight emphasis on 'source'—showing he understands the weight of the data. Professional but warm; no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広告のネーム、シンプル化に努めるようにしよう。
lines.en: Let's simplify the ad copy. Keep it clean.
lines.style: Measured directive. Not a demand—a collaborative decision stated with quiet authority. Brief pause before 'clean.' Eye-level confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 通話確認の議事録、写しを部内へ回します。
lines.en: I'll get copies of the call notes around to the team.
lines.style: Straightforward, action-oriented. No flourish. The tone of someone who's already mentally moving to the next task. Efficient without rushing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Warm close. Slight ease in the shoulders. Genuine appreciation without elaboration. The rhythm of a conversation that landed well.
